sentences.en: To love and to cherish, till death do us part.
sentences.zh: 爱与珍爱，直到死亡将我们分开。

sentences.en: I see linguistic diversity as a treasure to be cherished.
sentences.zh: 我视语言多样性为一种值得珍爱的财富。

sentences.en: Nicholas cherishes the relationships he's created with his classmates most.
sentences.zh: 尼古拉斯最珍爱的是他和同学们建立的关系。

senses.zh: 怀有（感情等）；抱有（希望等）
